## Problem statement

The tracked `.pi-config/agent/models.json` MunitoAI provider lists only `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash`. The MunitoAI API serves two DeepSeek models, and the operator wants the newer `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` also available.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `.pi-config/agent/models.json` exposes both paid MunitoAI DeepSeek models under one `MunitoAI` provider — `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash` (existing) and `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` (new) — with `apiKey: "$MUNITOAI_API_KEY"`; no credential is committed.
- [ ] Both models share the same limits: `contextWindow: 400000`, `maxTokens: 16384`, `input: ["text"]`, `api: "openai-completions"`.
- [ ] The unverified limits for the new model are flagged as unverified (see note below).
- [ ] Tracked JSON formatting and indentation are preserved.

## Note on "flagged as unverified"

JSON has no comment syntax, so the "code comment" flag cannot live inside `models.json`. The flag is recorded in `scripts/merge_pi_agent_config.py` (docstring/constant above the MunitoAI refresh) and in `docs/dev/skills-script-paths.md`. This resolution is an assumption; if the operator insists on an in-file marker, a non-standard `//` comment would make the file invalid JSON and is rejected.

## Key Files

- `.pi-config/agent/models.json` — add one entry to the MunitoAI models array

## Constraints

- Pure data change — no code or tests.
data.title: Update tracked models.json to add DeepSeek v4.1-flash-1017 to MunitoAI provider

## Failure Signature

- Test name: tests/test_implement_skill_session_per_child_doc.py (13 doc-hygiene failures from commit ea3959b16, SA-0MVYDCUWA001Z8K0)
- Failing commit: (not available)

## Evidence

- Short stderr/stdout excerpt (first 1k characters):

```
13 pre-existing failures on local dev base ea3959b16 (unpushed commit of SA-0MVYDCUWA001Z8K0), unrelated to any current slice:
1) tests/test_implement_skill_session_per_child_doc.py - 11 failures: _STEP_HEADING = "6.1. Parent recursion" no longer matches the relocated doc heading "### Relocated: Step 6.1 - Parent recursion (epic/parent items only)" in docs/dev/implement-skill-reference.md.
2) tests/test_report_wiring_hygiene.py::TestEveryWorkItemSkillWired::test_final_step_section_requires_pasting_report_into_response - case mismatch: the test wants lowercase "paste it verbatim into"; skill/implement/SKILL.md now has capital "Paste it verbatim into".
3) tests/test_test_skill_wiring.py::test_all_wired_files_reference_test_skill - skill/implement/SKILL.md no longer contains the "skill/test" or "/skill:test" marker after the SKILL.md rewrite (it now links ../test/SKILL.md and uses $(skill_path test)/scripts/run_tests.py).
Fix surface: skill/implement/SKILL.md + docs/dev/implement-skill-re
```

## Impact

Automated agent sessions can advance work items without being blocked by pre-existing doc-hygiene test failures that were inconsistent between tests and their reference documentation.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The test `tests/test_implement_skill_session_per_child_doc.py (13 doc-hygiene failures from commit ea3959b16, SA-0MVYDCUWA001Z8K0)` passes when run against the latest `dev`.
2. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes.
3. Full project test suite passes with the new changes.

## Suggested Triage Steps

1. Verify flakiness: rerun CI/test locally once.
2. If reproducible, assign to `Build` and route for triage.
3. If flaky, tag `flaky` and route to flaky-test queue.

## Fix Applied

Three doc-hygiene inconsistencies were resolved:

1. **`test_implement_skill_session_per_child_doc.py`** (11 failures): Updated `_STEP_HEADING` to match the relocated doc heading `### Relocated: Step 6.1 — Parent recursion (epic/parent items only)` in `docs/dev/implement-skill-reference.md`.

2. **`test_report_wiring_hygiene.py`** (1 failure): Updated `skill/implement/SKILL.md` to use the standard lowercase pattern `**paste it verbatim into**` consistent with all other work-item skills.

3. **`test_test_skill_wiring.py`** (1 failure): Added `/skill:test` marker to `skill/implement/SKILL.md` to maintain the test-skill wiring contract.

## Build & Test

- Changed-scope test run: 551 passed, 0 failed

data.description: In the usage report skill there is a very detailed description of the metrics in the first section. This detailed description should move to an appendix at the end of the document. We should add an equivalent description for all metrics in the report to the appendix. The main body should contain only the data generated. While building this description look for opportunities to improve the report by adding or removing metrics and/or restructuring the report. It has two intended uses. The first is to provide an "at a glance" view of how well the local LLMs are performing in terms of optimization of use and amount of content being processed. The second is to provide a detailed breakdown of each of these top level measures with the intention of enabling engineers or agents to improve on them.
